title: Peninsula Pleated Shorts - Tan
body_html:
Made for comfort, cut generously and tastefully. The Peninsula pleated short is simple at first glance but packed with features the closer you look. 

Double pleated fronts for comfort and classic style. Partial elasticated waistband for a dynamic fit that doesn't compromise class. Our very own take on tee storage at the rear right hip and, tonal MTG embroidery throughout.

Taylan is 181cm and wearing size 32.

  • 97% cotton, 3% elastane
  • Mid-weight fabric suitable for all weather
  • Relaxed over sized fit
  • Double pleats at front
  • Partial stretch waistband allows for variance in waist size 
  • Eyelets to hold your tees
Sizing
30 32 34 36
Waist circumference 80-86cm 85-91cm 90-96 95-101
Inseam length 22.5 22.5 22.5 22.5
